text.p: These are the leading stories in the Kenyan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Police shoot dead four suspected gangsters and recover four pistols.
- A mob lynches a deaf man and critically injures two other deaf men allegedly stealing maize from a garden.
- Eighteen people have died in road accidents in Kenya in the past three days.
- President Daniel arap Moi accuses the unregistered Safina party of backing university unrest.
- Kenya's chief justice calls for a government doctor's report on the health of two other prisoners jailed with Koigi wa Wamwere, who was released for medical treatment.
- A lawyer says the Public Order Act contravenes the freedom of expression and assembly as provided for in the constitution.
- President Moi elevates Malindi sub-district to a full district.
- Police in Kiambu district arrest 22 suspects in connection with a raid on Sunday.
